Name: SH's Hummingbirds for Custom Critters
Author: plurffle
Description:
This mod adds hummingbirds with the use of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255/]spacechase0's Custom Critters mod[/url]﻿! I was initially thinking about making them even smaller to be more accurate, but I figured the current size of these hummingbirds size fine. <3

How to Install:
1. Unzip the zip file.
2. Just drop the extracted folder in your Custom Critters folder. _(:3 」∠)_



I just created a Ko-fi! If you like my works, then feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
